subject: PulseCare POC: Evaluation Charter + Stakeholder Orientation
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Emma Li <emma@pulsecare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: PulseCare POC: Evaluation Charter + Stakeholder Orientation

Hi Emma —

Great to meet you on the demo yesterday. As discussed, attached is a first draft of an evaluation charter to get the POC moving fast. Highlights:

- What success looks like (go/no-go gates and target metrics)
- Benchmarks we will run (prompt sets, user scenarios, latency/quality targets)
- Owner roster for each deliverable (bench design, prompt ownership, infra)
- Tentative timeline oriented to a 6-week POC with a mid-point review

For transparency we've put the working MAP in Drive here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcdExampleDriveLink (PulseCare_MAP_v1.xlsx attached for quick reference).

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick orientation call next Tue 6/25 to align stakeholders and finalize success metrics (30 min)
2) Redwood will deliver the initial benchmark harness and the first prompt templates by 6/28
3) Mid-point quality review and go/no-go decision week of 7/15

Could you confirm who from PulseCare will be the technical owner for evaluation (we need 1-2 people to own test data and accept/reject samples) and whether procurement needs to be looped now?

Thanks — excited to partner.

—Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
naomi_feldman@redwood.com
Attachments: PulseCare_MAP_v1.xlsx
From: Emma Li <emma@pulsecare.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@pulsecare.com
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 11:02:12 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseCare POC: Evaluation Charter + Stakeholder Orientation

Hi Naomi —

Thanks for the doc and the clear timeline. I confirm: I will be the technical owner for the evaluation on PulseCare's side, and I will loop in Ravi in Procurement (procurement@pulsecare.com) for commercial matters.

A couple quick things from our side:
- Primary success metric: relevant answer rate (top-1 relevance) >= 88% across our triage set (200 cases)
- Secondary: hallucination rate < 5% on clinical content; latency p95 < 750ms for 512-token interactions
- We can share an initial sample of triage prompts by EOD Monday (6/24)

Would appreciate if Redwood can:
1) propose a short benchmark plan that maps to those metrics
2) flag any limitations on on-prem deployment latency assumptions or privacy constraints (we're sensitive to PHI handling)

Looking forward to Tue.

Best,
Emma Li
Lead Product Manager, PulseCare
emma@pulsecare.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@pulsecare.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Jun 2024 15:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseCare POC: Evaluation Charter + Stakeholder Orientation

Thanks Naomi / Emma — good clarity from PulseCare on targets. I propose we split ownership this way:

- Bench design & sampling: Marissa Cole (I will be primary for the evaluation harness and will coordinate sample labeling)
- Prompt templates & eval harness implementation: Priyom Das (he will own prompt variations, temperature sweeps, and sample logging)
- Acceptance criteria & go/no-go recommendation: Naomi Feldman (drive the business decision with Emma)
- Security/compliance redlines: Sean Gallagher (added to thread in a follow-up)

Tentative milestone plan (short):
- 6/24: PulseCare shares triage sample set (200 cases)
- 6/28: Redwood delivers initial prompt templates and harness (eval-bench-plan.md attached)
- 7/08: Run first benchmark and share dashboard + example failures
- 7/15: Mid-point review meeting (go/no-go recommendation)

Action items for us: Priyom, can you confirm what the minimal harness looks like (metrics, logging) and whether we need any infra access from PulseCare? Emma, will your team provide a small S3 or secure upload for the sample set or do you want Redwood to host?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
Attachments: eval-bench-plan.md
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma@pulsecare.com>
Date: Sat, 22 Jun 2024 08:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PulseCare POC: Evaluation Charter + Stakeholder Orientation

Marissa / Naomi / Emma —

I'll take the prompt ownership. Quick notes on the harness and what I'll deliver by 6/28:

- deliverables: prompt-templates.zip (seed prompts + variations), eval-bench-plan.md (detailed metrics and bench commands), harness script (Docker + runbook)
- core metrics we'll compute: top-1 relevance, hallucination rate (manual review sample + heuristic flags), response latency p50/p95, token usage/cost estimate
- infra assumptions: best-effort hosted run on Redwood's dedicated stack (no PHI stored); if PulseCare wants on-prem, we need a short security onboarding (SOC2 summary requested)

Attachments to follow: prompt-templates.zip (stub), eval-bench-plan.md

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Applied ML Engineer, Redwood Inference
